thread.title: Index Funds: Apple Loses Support As Growth Stocks Lead Sell-off

author: NANCY GONDO
title: Index Funds: Apple Loses Support As Growth Stocks Lead Sell-off
text:
Key index funds sold off hard across the board amid heightened trade-war fears . Apple ( AAPL ), Facebook ( FB ) and other growth stocks were among the hardest hit.
X Invesco QQQ Trust ( QQQ ) sank 2.7% in afternoon trade as the FANG stocks tumbled. QQQ is close to testing its 50-day moving average. Amazon ( AMZN ) fell 3%, Facebook and Alphabet ( GOOGL ) 4% each, and Netflix ( NFLX ) plunged nearly 6%.
Apple dropped 2% to breach its 50-day line for the first time since May 1. That weighed on SPDR Dow Jones industrial average ( DIA ), which was down 1.5% as it slid below its 200-day line for the first time in nearly two months. McDonald's ( MCD ), Visa ( V ) and Intel ( INTC ) were the biggest blue chip losers, with each giving up 3% or more.
SPDR S&P 500 ( SPY ) also fell 1.5%. The broad index undercut its 50-day line for the first time since early May. Even small-cap funds weren't spared as iShares Russell 2000 Growth ( IWO ) skidded 1.9%. Foreign stocks sold off too: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ( EEM ) lost 1.6% and iShares MSCI EAFE ( EFA ) shed 1.3%.
